text:
Author: Up-Chuk
Post: https://discord.com/channels/766364534495117383/1286801164326797385/1527815954396872844
Doc: <https://docs.google.com/document/d/1EVO4LnP9uUd0AHErrfhev9u5pc6v9qQg8bg2lPI-TqM/edit?usp=sharing>
Summary:
- Allows casting Pouch while already holding a spell.
- If Pouch is interrupted, the held spell activates on the caster.
- Standardizes 'stored/held' terminology to 'pouched'.
- Still one pouched spell at a time, and only the caster can invoke it.
answer-1: Yes
answer-2: No
answer-3: Abstain
